done.prompt: Use case: product-mockup, identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body studio fashion photograph for SIDEFORM Plain Box Tee in BLACK. Image 1 is the EXACT model identity and outfit to preserve: same adult person, face, hair, skin, build, expression. Image 2 is the EXACT selected garment construction/color reference. Image 3 is FRAMING/LIGHTING ONLY, not its model or tee: head-to-toe, head and both entire white sneakers visible with clear modest margins, pale grey/off-white studio background, soft shadow, portrait 4:5. Zoom out from image 1 into a relaxed natural slightly three-quarter stance, with the exact Plain Box Tee silhouette, Boxy and oversized with a slightly cropped body. Preserve pockets, seams, neckline, sleeves, cuffs, fastening and 260 gsm cotton jersey. Preserve the small two offset horizontal rectangle chest logo, off-white on black, black on white/grey. Pair with unbranded grey wide trousers as in reference and plain white low-top sneakers; no logos on trousers. Show the same garment in BLACK, not a different design. Preserve same model and styling across this product’s colors. Single photograph, no collage, typography, captions, props, new branding or watermark.
